summary: Borr Drilling Ltd, via subsidiary Borr IHC Limited, completed a cash tender offer and consent solicitation for its 10.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2028 and 10.375% Senior Secured Notes due 2030. The offers covered any and all outstanding notes, with 95.95% of 2028 Notes and 91.21% of 2030 Notes tendered, representing 94.11% aggregate. Tender consideration was $998.36 per $1,000 for 2028 Notes and $1,010.00 for 2030 Notes, multiplied by an amortization factor. Over 90% tenders met the indenture threshold; the remaining notes will be redeemed. This is a liability management exercise, not a M&A or restructuring event.
